user.title: Connect to Pi-hole v6
user.description: Enter a host without a scheme or path, the web/API port, and an application password. HTTPS uses the port exactly as entered; it is not changed automatically. For a self-signed certificate, turn off HTTPS certificate verification.

data_description.host: Enter only a hostname or IP address; do not include a URL, port, or path.
data_description.port: The web/API port is used as entered (for example, 80 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS).
data_description.use_https: Without HTTPS, the password is sent unencrypted over your network.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for trusted self-signed certificates.
data_description.password: Create an application password in Pi-hole.

reconfigure.title: Change the Pi-hole connection
reconfigure.description: The connection is validated before it is saved. Confirm whether this is the same server or a replacement Pi-hole. Protocol and port are used as entered; a blank password keeps the saved one.

data.host: Hostname or IP address, without a URL or path

reauth_confirm.title: Update Pi-hole credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Pi-hole rejected the stored credential. Enter a new application password for {host}.

error.invalid_host: Enter a DNS hostname or IP address only. Do not include a URL scheme, port, path, or credentials.
error.already_configured: Another Pi-hole entry already uses that host, protocol, and port.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Pi-hole v6 API. Check the host, port, protocol, and that /api/docs is available.
error.ssl_certificate: Home Assistant does not trust Pi-hole's HTTPS certificate. If it is self-signed, turn off certificate verification.

abort.reconfigure_entry_not_found: The Pi-hole entry to change could not be found.
abort.reconfigure_entry_changed: The entry changed while the connection was being validated. Start reconfiguration again.

init.title: Polling and Activity
init.description: Choose whether the integration sends new query events to Home Assistant Activity. Query details are not retained by the integration.

data_description.retention_mode: Activity enabled sends entries according to the Activity setting. Totals only suppresses new Activity entries.
data_description.activity_mode: Choose all events, blocked events only, or none. Totals only always disables Activity entries.
data_description.unusual_activity: Creates a binary sensor per device that turns on when it stays far above its own usual activity. Evaluated every 5 minutes from Recorder statistics.

options.same_source: Same Pi-hole; keep its cursor and identity
options.new_source: Replacement Pi-hole; start a new generation
